cases.name: session-mood-recognition-status-contract-tests
command:
set -euo pipefail
REPO_ROOT="$(cd ../../.. && pwd)"
export REPO_ROOT
python3 - <<'PY_CONTRACT_EOF'
"""Deterministic contract check: recognition status propagation in live_chain_receipt.

Drives run_recognition() with a stubbed child interpreter so the parent's
wrapping path is exercised on real artifacts, with no Chatterbox, no GPU and no
Memory traffic.
"""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(os.environ["REPO_ROOT"]).resolve()
MOD = REPO / "skills/persona-dream/scripts/live_chain_receipt.py"
REAL_BLOCKED = REPO / (
    "skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v5/continuity/reliability/"
    "soak35_accepted_candidate_readback/cycle_019/voice_recognition/RECEIPT.json"
)

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("live_chain_receipt", MOD)
lcr = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules["live_chain_receipt"] = lcr
spec.loader.exec_module(lcr)

failures = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + name + ((" :: " + detail) if detail and not cond else ""))
    if not cond:
        failures.append(name)


def stub(body: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="pd-stub-")) / "stub-python"
    path.write_text(
        "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
        "import sys, pathlib\n"
        "args = sys.argv[1:]\n"
        "out = pathlib.Path(args[args.index('--out') + 1])\n"
        "out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n"
        + body
        + "\nsys.stderr.write('stub stderr tail\\n')\nsys.exit(1)\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    path.chmod(path.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)
    return path


def run(body):
    out = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="pd-out-")) / "voice_recognition" / "RECEIPT.json"
    try:
        lcr.run_recognition(REPO / "does-not-matter.json", out, stub(body))
    except BaseException as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - the exception IS the contract
        return exc
    raise AssertionError("run_recognition did not raise on a non-zero child")


real = json.loads(REAL_BLOCKED.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
check("real_artifact_is_domain_blocked", real["status"] == "BLOCKED_SESSION_MOOD_VOICE_RECOGNITION")
check("real_artifact_failed_gate", real["failed_gates"] == ["all_renders_recognized_as_embry"], str(real["failed_gates"]))
check("real_artifact_backend_error_null", real["backend_error"] is None)

# 1. valid structured domain block -> propagated, not COMMAND_FAILED
exc = run(f"out.write_text({json.dumps(json.dumps(real))}, encoding='utf-8')")
DomainBlocked = getattr(lcr, "RecognitionDomainBlocked", None)
check("domain_block_type", DomainBlocked is not None and isinstance(exc, DomainBlocked), type(exc).__name__)
msg = str(exc)
check("domain_block_not_command_failed", "BLOCKED_RECOGNITION_COMMAND_FAILED" not in msg)
check("domain_block_status_in_message", "BLOCKED_SESSION_MOOD_VOICE_RECOGNITION" in msg)
check("domain_block_stage_token_preserved", "BLOCKED_RECOGNITION" in msg)
d = getattr(exc, "detail", {})
check("detail_status", d.get("status") == "BLOCKED_SESSION_MOOD_VOICE_RECOGNITION")
check("detail_failed_gates", d.get("failed_gates") == ["all_renders_recognized_as_embry"])
check("detail_min_threshold", (d.get("preregistered_thresholds") or {}).get("min_embry_similarity") == 0.75)
check("detail_separation", d.get("separation") == real["separation"])
check("detail_backend_error_key", "backend_error" in d and d["backend_error"] is None)
check("detail_child_returncode", (d.get("child_process") or {}).get("returncode") == 1)
check("detail_child_stderr_tail", "stub stderr tail" in (d.get("child_process") or {}).get("stderr_tail", ""))
scores = d.get("genuine_renders") or []
check("detail_per_render_count", len(scores) == len(real["genuine_renders"]))
check("detail_per_render_similarity", any(r.get("similarity_to_embry") == 0.767638 for r in scores))
check("detail_duration_aware_floor", [r.get("duration_aware_floor") for r in scores] == [r.get("duration_aware_floor") for r in real["genuine_renders"]] and 0.772462 in [r.get("duration_aware_floor") for r in scores])
check("detail_render_gate_flags", any(r.get("passes_duration_aware_floor") is False for r in scores))
adv = d.get("adversarial_voices") or []
check("detail_adversarial_scores", len(adv) == len(real["adversarial_voices"]) and all("similarity_to_embry" in r for r in adv))
check("detail_receipt_sha256", str(d.get("sha256", "")).startswith("sha256:"))
check("detail_marked_propagated", d.get("propagated_from_child_receipt") is True)

# 2..n. everything else stays COMMAND_FAILED
mocked = dict(real, mocked=True)
passing = dict(real, status="PASS_SESSION_MOOD_VOICE_RECOGNITION", failed_gates=[])
unknown = dict(real, status="BLOCKED_SOMETHING_ELSE")
noschema = {k: v for k, v in real.items() if k != "schema"}
nogates = dict(real, failed_gates=[])
negatives = {
    "missing_receipt": "pass",
    "malformed_receipt": "out.write_text('{not json', encoding='utf-8')",
    "unreadable_receipt": "out.write_bytes(b'\\xff\\xfe\\x00garbage')",
    "wrong_schema": f"out.write_text({json.dumps(json.dumps(noschema))}, encoding='utf-8')",
    "mocked_receipt": f"out.write_text({json.dumps(json.dumps(mocked))}, encoding='utf-8')",
    "unrecognized_status": f"out.write_text({json.dumps(json.dumps(unknown))}, encoding='utf-8')",
    "passing_status_with_nonzero_exit": f"out.write_text({json.dumps(json.dumps(passing))}, encoding='utf-8')",
    "blocked_without_failed_gates": f"out.write_text({json.dumps(json.dumps(nogates))}, encoding='utf-8')",
}
for name, body in negatives.items():
    exc = run(body)
    check(
        f"command_failed_reserved_for_{name}",
        type(exc) is RuntimeError and str(exc).startswith("BLOCKED_RECOGNITION_COMMAND_FAILED:"),
        f"{type(exc).__name__}:{str(exc)[:120]}",
    )

# invariants: nothing about thresholds, floors, ASR or the gate itself moved
rec_src = (REPO / "skills/persona-dream/scripts/session_mood_voice_recognition.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
check("recognition_thresholds_unchanged", "MIN_EMBRY_SIMILARITY = 0.75" in rec_src and "MIN_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE_SIMILARITY = 0.75" in rec_src, "threshold literal not found")
check("recognition_gate_still_enforced", 'failed_gates.append("all_renders_recognized_as_embry")' in rec_src)
lcr_src = MOD.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
check("parent_still_validates_pass_receipts", 'raise ValueError("BLOCKED_RECOGNITION_RECEIPT_FAILED")' in lcr_src)

print(json.dumps({"failures": failures}, sort_keys=True))
if failures:
    sys.exit(1)
print("RECOGNITION_STATUS_CONTRACT_OK")
PY_CONTRACT_EOF

capability_claims.description: The run.sh pipeline run --step crew_casting command can write a schema-valid, receipt-backed crew_contract.json from a selector payload and reject out-of-pool selections. Fixture-backed evidence proves wiring only; live ask tau-dag selector proof is separate.
Persona Dream refuses unfunded API-key image lanes and routes create_panel --backend scillm through ask image generation with Codex OAuth instead of the unsupported $create-image scillm backend.

The retained story-contract work-order executor consumes a validated work order, emits a validated accepted story_contract.json plus fulfillment/review/stale receipts, and refuses to promote stale storyboard or Kling artifacts.

The retained storyboard-panel work-order executor consumes a validated work order, emits a validated storyboard_panel_receipt.json plus continuity ledger, and refuses provider/Kling calls or storyboard_packet promotion.

The retained panel-repair work-order executor consumes a validated work order, emits a validator-facing panel repair gate receipt, rejects forbidden final-image backends, and refuses provider eligibility until a public media probe passes.
The executable Persona Dream spine carries the autonomous cycle journal into a spoken_journal terminal node without requiring generate-lane dream_packet artifacts.
The corrected operational goal and PD-CORRECTED-GOAL-V1 sealed manifest are pinned with deterministic fail-closed validators before any live paired run can be claimed.
The 35-cycle reliability soak is gated by a frozen source-dream diversity and normalized state-transition preflight with typed negative controls and zero provider/canonical-write side effects.
Session mood maps dream/journal conflict into Chatterbox delivery fields while preserving one invariant answer body and using calibrated pace values instead of request-only delivery labels.

A valid structured BLOCKED_SESSION_MOOD_VOICE_RECOGNITION receipt from the recognition subprocess is propagated into the live-chain block with its failed gates, per-render scores, thresholds, duration-aware floor, separation, adversarial scores, backend_error and child exit metadata; BLOCKED_RECOGNITION_COMMAND_FAILED stays reserved for missing, malformed, unreadable, unrecognized or crash-before-receipt children.
Persona Dream records Chatterbox backend/profile/range registry matches and refuses perceived-emotion claims unless a hash-bound registry entry exactly permits the recorded scope.

Persona Dream research hypotheses terminate through a machine-readable registry that recomputes receipt hashes, checks result/product/transfer consistency, and refuses immutable-goal completion while required hypotheses remain nonterminal.

Persona Dream restart and stale-session recovery is exercised as seven retained fault scenarios with hash-bound receipts, duplicate-effect accounting, typed stale/tampered controls, and explicit live service restart proof when requested.

Rendered-and-Watch-observed dream media value is evaluated through a provider-free M/R/D/DW matched ablation with sealed commitments, zero canonical writes, typed negative controls, and terminal null/positive/negative disposition.
DreamWorkspace renders its full skeleton without runtime ReferenceErrors (2026-08-19 blank-page incident).
The dream API host lists real runs (including the recovered surf run) and refuses paths outside its roots.
The residue board's stratified sample keeps image, video, and audio memories through the 12-card cut against live memory recall.
The documented run.sh command surface exposes converse-dynamic and dispatches it to the dynamic Horus/Embry conversation CLI instead of falling through to usage.

Horus and Embry hold a DYNAMIC audible conversation: each Horus turn drafted live by Tau from her journal and the transcript (proven by Tau receipt provenance and conditioned-on-reply oracles), spoken in his own voice; both roles voiced first-class in conversation.jsonl with tone + sha256-bound audio.

Autonomous dream-cycle recall gates preserve ranked recall rows, probe ranks, and the negative-control dream rank in the receipt so pass/block outcomes are auditable without a second mutable live recall.
The listener-study target stimuli can be rendered through live Chatterbox with one shared norm_loudness policy and hash-bound back into both preregistration files.
Embry speaker identity can be preregistered, rendered, and scored across a frozen 4 mood x 3 text x 3 seed matrix with calibration-derived identity thresholds and adversarial comparisons.

One complete persona-dream run start to finish in a fresh run dir: day ingest, Tau dream spine (select/instrument/observe/interpret/ToM/persist with exact re-read + dream journal), tone-annotated day journal, ASR-verified spoken journal, memory write, artifact store, a 3-pair fully audible dynamic Horus/Embry conversation about the dream, the day, and her mood (every turn tone + sha256-bound audio), and carry-back into memory with read-back equality.
